data.title: Fraunhofer researchers aim to unlock the potential of lithium-metal anodes
data.description: Researchers from two Fraunhofer Institutes are exploring new approaches to improving the performance and lifespan of battery systems. One idea is to use lithium itself as an active anode material in lithium-metal anodes, thereby achieving higher specific capacity in battery cells.

data.title: India: Jindal Stainless deploys 10 electric heavy-duty trucks
data.description: Indian steel manufacturer Jindal Stainless has added ten heavy-duty electric trucks to its fleet. For the first time, the company is using electric trucks to transport finished goods, building on its earlier introduction of alternative-fuel vehicles running on LNG and CNG.

data.title: Australia to fund 130-vehicle commercial V2G trial
data.description: The Australian Renewable Energy Agency (ARENA) has committed AU$4 million to a project which will deploy vehicle-to-grid technology across a fleet of 130 EVs. The three-year project aims to explore whether fleets can reduce operating costs by providing grid services without compromising on day-to-day operations.

data.title: Chery launches megawatt charging system for passenger EVs
data.description: In China, Chery has entered the megawatt charging race. Following the introduction of megawatt charging solutions by BYD, Geely, and Huawei, the state-owned automaker now presents a charger with 1.44 MW peak output.

data.title: BAIC and CATL aim to accelerate battery swap approach
data.description: Chinese automakers BAIC Group and CATL are deepening their partnership in the field of passenger car battery swapping: BAIC plans to develop more compatible models and advance the construction of swapping stations with the help of its dealer network.

data.title: Price reduction at market launch: Jetta M6 enters the Chinese market
data.description: VW's sub-brand is launching the Jetta M6 at dealerships in China. With the market launch, the manufacturer is also adjusting the pre-sale prices downward by 1,000 yuan (~€134 euros). Read on for more details on what makes this mid-size sedan stand out, along with key data for the three available versions.

data.title: Bosch faces radical corporate restructuring amid competitive pressures
data.description: The Bosch Group is undergoing an internal corporate restructuring. From August 1, 2027, the Mobility business sector will exist as an independent subsidiary, among others. Three additional areas will also be transferred to subsidiary companies. The group aims to enhance its competitiveness and operate with greater flexibility.

data.title: Mercedes in high demand as six-month lead time for CLA and GLC
data.description: Mercedes-Benz is surprised by the high demand for its all-electric models CLA and GLC. Currently, the delivery time for both vehicles is six months. The battery plant in Kamenz has been operating six days a week in a three-shift system since June to secure the supply of traction batteries.

data.title: First drive in the Xpeng L03: finally a Chinese EV that doesn’t beep
data.description: With the L03, Xpeng brings its established strengths to a new price and size segment. Particularly in the Ultra variant, its equipment goes well beyond what many rivals offer. Given its competitive pricing, the occasional shortcoming we identified during our first test drive is easier to overlook. Deliveries in Europe are scheduled to begin later this year.

data.title: Audi China appoints Jeff Zhang and Rolf Michl as new dual leadership
data.description: Audi is reshaping its leadership team for its China business. Starting in November, Jeff Zhang will replace Johannes Roschek as President of Audi China. Additionally, Rolf Michl, previously CEO of Audi Sport GmbH, will move to China as Chief Operating Officer.

data.title: Holger Scherr leaves Daimler Truck for SuperPanther
data.description: Chinese e-truck manufacturer SuperPanther has appointed Dr. Holger Scherr to its European management team. Scherr will serve as Executive Vice President Europe, overseeing the establishment and expansion of the company's European operations. The appointment is a coup for SuperPanther, as Scherr joins the startup from Daimler Truck.

data.title: London considers mandating BEVs for new ride-hailing licences
data.description: Transport for London (TfL) has launched a consultation on stricter licensing rules for ride-hailing services, such as Uber. TfL is considering requiring all newly licensed vehicles to be fully electric from 2028. Wheelchair-accessible vehicles would have a transition period until July 2030.

data.title: Electrify America opens its largest EV charging station to date
data.description: The new charging site has opened in Orlando, Florida, and features 24 DC fast chargers capable of delivering up to 350 kW each. It's located at the Sand Lake Corners South shopping centre and serves both local drivers and visitors travelling to nearby attractions, including Disney World and Universal Studios.

data.title: India: Switch Mobility starts fulfilling 50-unit intercity electric bus order
data.description: Switch Mobility has delivered six intercity electric buses to Purple Bus, the operating brand of Pune (Maharashtra)-based Indian private bus operator Prasanna Purple Mobility Solutions. These buses form the first batch of a 50-unit order the company announced in August.

data.title: Greater range at the same weight: silicon battery passes laboratory test
data.description: A critical breakthrough in battery research saw film cells with silicon-rich anodes endure over 1,000 cycles in testing without dropping below 80 per cent capacity. We explore the parameters that play a key role and what this progress could mean for electric vehicles.

data.title: GM announces new efficient EV platform
data.description: GM has streamlined its development processes and introduced a new platform in a shorter timeframe, with the first production vehicles set to debut "very soon". From 2028, vehicles on the platform will also feature significantly more efficient batteries and a faster, centralised computing system.

data.title: Bosch bets on electric drives for trucks – while still backing hydrogen
data.description: Bosch sees significant growth potential in the commercial vehicle sector and aims to broadly support the technological transformation of trucks. At the IAA Transportation, Jan-Oliver Röhrl, Executive Vice President Commercial Vehicles and Off-Road at Bosch, spoke with electrive about e-axles, the lack of charging infrastructure, hydrogen - and why Europe should not rule out options too early when it comes to new technologies.

data.title: CATL’s Akin Li: “Whichever battery type the market demands, we’ll have it”
data.description: CATL is a near-indispensable supplier to the emerging European e-truck industry, with many model series from local manufacturers running on cells or entire battery packs from the Chinese company. We met with CATL’s top manager Akin Li to explore how CATL plans to further strengthen its partnerships with Europe’s truck manufacturers.

data.title: BEV registrations rose sharply across Europe in September
data.description: Registrations of electric cars in the EU rose sharply in September. According to ACEA, 290,117 pure electric cars were newly registered - 72.9 per cent more than in the same month last year. This put their market share at 29.9 per cent in September. Since the beginning of the year, BEVs have achieved a market share of 22.7 per cent.

data.title: Tesla Q3 results: full order books, but declining figures
data.description: Tesla's revenue is stagnating, with the US electric car manufacturer witnessing a significant drop in profits during the third quarter. However, the Americans' car business is not doing poorly - order books are full. The reasons lie elsewhere.
